concerns.text: FR-001 requires ingesting DFT data 'from Materials Project and NOMAD', but T003 fetches only 'the verified HuggingFace dataset'. No task ingests from Materials Project or NOMAD (they appear only in T002's experimental-data search). The FR as specified has no covering task; either add a task covering the specified sources or record a spec amendment.

Constitution Principle VII makes external experimental validation 'mandatory before reporting feature importance shifts', yet T010 explicitly says 'Do not raise a blocking error on missing external data' and T008/T009 report importance shifts regardless. No task enforces the mandatory gate; the plan's FAIL(Data Gap) note acknowledges this but no spec amendment exists. Coverage of FR-006/Principle VII as written is absent.

US-2 scenario 2 requires comparing feature importance 'between 1V and 4V' and identifying a descriptor entering the top 3 at 4V absent at 1V. T008 compares only low (0–2V) vs high bins over potentials {0,2,4}; no task computes or tests the 1V-vs-4V comparison, so this acceptance scenario has no covering task.

T005 introduces 'code/utils/reaction_engine.py' (RDKit + pubchempy dynamic stoichiometry), which does not exist in the plan's project structure and contradicts the plan/data-model's hardcoded reaction lookup table design for FR-008. The task set covers FR-008 via a mechanism the plan does not define; align the task with the planned lookup table or amend the plan.

FR-003 requires ≥5 geometric features; T004 claims '≥5 geometric features' but the dataset schema (which T006's contract test enforces) defines only 4 geometric fields (max/min bond length, mean bond angle, max dihedral). No task adds the missing geometric field(s) or updates the contract, so the implemented matrix cannot satisfy FR-003.

The dependency section states 'T001–T002 (done)' and the Revision behavior section says they are 'preserved as checked', but both T001 and T002 checkboxes are unchecked ('- [ ]'), leaving the completed state ambiguous to an implementer.
